context:
Goal: no session can fake your saved answer on this page.
Problem (rule): the new answer guard must either refuse or allow a session deleting your saved answer, and your ruling on the guard's words does not say which.
Based on (read): a saved answer is stored as an answer record, and sessions act on it as your word; the new guard (built in lane answers-session-write-guard, not merged) refuses any session that writes or edits one, so no session can make up a pick for you.
Based on (read): triage deletes your answer record when it rewords or reopens an item, so the page asks you again (skill waiting-page); since today a close keeps it (step answer-kept-on-close).
Based on (read): a delete cannot fake a pick; at worst it loses one, and the item shows as unanswered again.
Departs from: main has no answer guard — adds one that refuses writes to answers, with or without deletes.
home: step answers-session-write-guard (a session cannot forge your page answers)

options.gain: Triage keeps rewording and reopening items with no extra step from you; no fake answer can be written.
options.how: The guard refuses set, update and str_replace on answers; a delete passes. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Allow a delete
options.lose: A stray delete of your answer is not stopped; the item shows unanswered and you save it again.

options.gain: Your saved answer can never vanish by a session's act.
options.how: Every session write to answers is refused, a delete included.
options.label: Refuse a delete too (Recommended)
options.lose: Each time triage rewords or reopens an item you already answered, you type override in triage's session.
